name: cedservice-verticals
description: CED Service growth platform — assessment verticals, Business Record, and intelligence layer.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

comments.moduleFormat: Deliberately no "type": "module". The shared/ schema files are dual CommonJS/browser scripts loaded directly by static pages with no build step; declaring the package as ESM would break both. Server code uses .mjs, which Node and Vercel treat as ESM regardless.
comments.dependencies: @supabase/supabase-js is the only production dependency and is imported lazily inside the endpoint, so the unit suite runs without it installed. test:integration DOES require it.
comments.testScripts: test and test:unit are deliberately identical and never touch a database — the default must be safe. test:integration writes permanent, append-only rows to a real Supabase development project and refuses to run without explicit opt-in; see tests/integration/README.md.
